with_issues.note: correctness(low): portal_saved_searches.match_count is int4 and the watermark advance is `match_count = match_count + N`. PR #2812's own new test (failed_watermark_advance_rolls_back_enqueue) proves the failure mode -- once match_count nears i32::MAX the advance overflows int4, aborts the now-atomic tx, rolls back, and the search wedges permanently: never advances last_matched_at, never sends alerts again, no self-recovery/alerting. Proposed: widen column to bigint (migration + i64), OR saturate via LEAST(match_count + N, 2147483647) so last_matched_at still advances. Latent/pre-existing (fix itself is correct & well-tested); low severity but unbounded+monotonic+silent.

with_issues.note: security(medium): resolve_client_ip() trusts leftmost X-Forwarded-For / CF-Connecting-IP with no trusted-proxy verification. Same value keys the #2773 protected-share brute-force throttle AND the audit log, so a client rotating a spoofed XFF gets a fresh token:ip bucket per request -> defeats #2773's limiter; also poisons access-log source IP. Proposed: gate header trust on socket peer being in a trusted-proxy (Cloudflare CIDR) allowlist, prefer CF-Connecting-IP, take rightmost-untrusted XFF hop; centralise (routes::forms::submissions has the same leftmost-XFF exposure).
